statusReason: The verification machine's DNS resolver times out for every name under gugik.gov.pl and geoportal.gov.pl (uldk, opis.html docs host), so no fresh ULDK request was made. Public resolvers return an A record for uldk.gugik.gov.pl, and the zone's two authoritative nameservers (dns1.geoportal.gov.pl, ns.codgik.gov.pl) did not answer UDP/53 queries from this network. Pinning the resolution was refused by the session's permission policy, and server hosts were out of scope. tmp/adapter-staging/poland/live-verify.mjs performs the full verification wherever the host resolves.

service.documentationAccess: Not opened directly this session (same DNS failure). Content was taken from search-index excerpts of opis.html and from three independent open-source clients, as listed per observation below.

requestsNotUsed.GetParcelByIdOrNr: Accepts a precinct name plus parcel number and can return several parcels with a count status line; not an exact-ID read.
requestsNotUsed.area enumeration: None documented; ULDK is a per-object lookup.

observations.finding: text/plain; first line is the status, following lines are records whose '|'-separated fields follow the order of the result parameter.
basis: opis.html search excerpt: first line status, second line geometry; a plain request returns a two-line file
QGIS plugin envirosolutionspl/uldk_gugik request.py parses fields by result order

observations.finding: '0' followed by exactly one record for GetParcelByXY and GetParcelById.
basis: rgugik R/parcel_get.R: '"0" means no server side errors'

observations.finding: Multi-object replies (e.g. name searches) start with a count line such as '2'; the adapter rejects any status other than '0' plus one record.
'-1 brak wyników' is the no-result reply.
basis: QGIS plugin constants.py ULDK_NO_RESULTS = "-1 brak wyników" compared as a whole line
search excerpt of a ULDK reply page showing '-1 brak wyników'

observations.finding: Errors are also '-1 <message>' lines, e.g. '-1 wystąpił bład'; the plugin additionally filters lines containing 'błęd' or 'XML'. A '-1' line alone therefore does not mean absence.

xy is read in the WKT axis order of the SRID given as its third value (longitude,latitude for 4326; easting,northing for 2180); srid selects the output CRS, default 2180. Output geometry is EWKT 'SRID=4326;POLYGON((lon lat,...))'.
basis: opis.html search excerpt: order follows the WKT representation of the chosen system; srid=4326 example
2026-09-29 live: xy=21.0122,52.2297,4326 returned Warsaw parcel 146510_8.0502.1/3 with lon-first coordinates
rgugik passes 2180 as Y,X of its geodetic naming, i.e. easting,northing
observations.runtimeGuard: Every point hit must contain the queried [lon, lat]; a swapped reading cannot pass.

observations.finding: ULDK resolves each parcel from county (powiat) EGiB data; counties that have not connected or whose data is stale return nothing or outdated parcels.
basis: mscanner.pl county pages and C-Geo forum via search (secondary)
bazaazbestowa.gov.pl FAQ 17: ULDK may lag recent subdivisions
gis-support.pl 2025-01-03 outage note (precinct search failed nationally)

identity.format: WWPPGG_R.OOOO[.AR_N].NR_DZ — voivodeship WW, county PP, commune GG, commune type R, four-digit precinct OOOO, optional map sheet AR_N, parcel number NR_DZ (natural number or fraction).
identity.charset: digits, '_', '.', '/', and the literal 'AR_' sheet marker; no spaces, '|' or line breaks (both are reply separators).
formatBasis: GUGiK geoportal EGiB page via search: WWPPGG_R.XXXX.NDZ with optional AR_NR sheet
identity.unverified: Real-world IDs with letters, multi-level fractions or non-numeric sheet numbers were not sampled; such IDs would be rejected (502) rather than accepted.

absenceSemantics.explicitAbsence: Only a reply whose single line is exactly '-1 brak wyników' (NFC, optional trailing spaces/newline) for that request: point -> features [], exact ID -> absentIds [id].
absenceSemantics.unavailable: Network errors, timeouts, non-2xx, non-text/plain, invalid UTF-8, empty bodies, count lines, any other '-1' message, records that fail ID/WKT/containment checks.
absenceSemantics.knownLimitation: ULDK does not distinguish 'parcel does not exist' from 'county data missing or stale' in its no-result reply (secondary sources). Absence is therefore 'not in ULDK now', not proof of deletion. Not verified live.
absenceSemantics.httpStatusPolicy: 403 -> parcel-source-blocked, 429 -> parcel-source-rate-limited with Retry-After, never retried by the adapter.

liveVerification.summary: 51 of 53 uncovered Polish UN cities passed: point hit containing the query point, fresh-adapter exact-ID read with identical geometry, explicit absence for a format-valid missing ID. Stopped at Bełchatów, whose absence reply carried an extra unhandled-service fragment (treated as unavailable, not absence); Piotrków Trybunalski not reached.

fixture.provenance: Reconstructed, not a raw capture: the ULDK reply for 046101_1.0128.268/2 in the adapter's result=id,geom_wkt form, rebuilt from bydgoszcz-parcel-sample.geojson with vertex 24 latitude restored to the source value 53.126844057528 recorded in root-review-receipts/city_1852.json.

unitTests.mutationChecks: Seven deliberate adapter mutations (no containment check, no ID echo check, any '-1' as absence, multi-record accepted, no pacing, no last-start pacing, 3D WKT accepted) each turned at least one test red; the restored adapter is green.

uncoveredCities.derivation: UN WUP 2025 cities with ISO2 PL and Year 2025 (60), minus City_Codes that already have a wup2025:<code> entry in frontend/data/world-coverage.json (1381, 1580, 2093, 2942, 3120, 3234, 3608). This gives 53; the brief said 52, so one more city may be counted as covered elsewhere.

coverageCaveats: Coverage depends on each county's EGiB integration with ULDK; no official list of non-integrated counties was found.
ULDK may lag recent subdivisions (Baza Azbestowa FAQ).
National ULDK outages have been reported (gis-support.pl, 2025-01-03); the adapter maps them to unavailable, never to absence, unless ULDK itself answers '-1 brak wyników'.
Legal title, survey accuracy and currentness are not established by this lookup.
